title: Christmas gifts under £20 UK 2026: Lego, tech and stocking fillers
seoTitle: Christmas Gifts Under £20 UK 2026: 9 Ideas They'll Use
description: The best Christmas gifts under £20 in the UK at Black Friday prices: Lego Botanicals £11.99, Back to the Future Lego £14.99, Fire TV Stick HD £17.99.
intro:
**Our best Christmas gift under £20 this year is the Lego Botanicals Happy Plants set at £11.99, its lowest price ever at Amazon. Best for film fans: the Lego Back to the Future Time Machine at £14.99. Best practical gift: a 45W power bank for £17.70.**

Every price below was published on 20 or 21 November 2026, during Amazon's Black Friday Week (19–30 November), so check the product page before you buy. Some Amazon prices need Prime. For more ideas, see all our [Christmas gift guides](/christmas-gifts/) and [every Black Friday 2026 guide](/black-friday/).

deals.name: Lego Botanicals Happy Plants (10349)
deals.note: Three tiny potted plants that never need watering, and a relaxing build for an adult or a teenager. GamesRadar reports it has never been cheaper. Our [Lego Black Friday guide](/guides/lego-black-friday-deals-2026/) has bigger sets.

deals.name: Lego Speed Champions Back to the Future Time Machine (77256)
deals.note: The DeLorean in Lego form, a lovely desk ornament for any film fan aged 9 to 90. Also at a record low, per GamesRadar.

deals.name: Loop Quiet 2 ear plugs
deals.note: Soft, reusable plugs for light sleepers, snorers' partners and noisy commutes. TechRadar calls this a record-low price, and they look neat enough to be a proper present.

deals.name: Amazon Fire TV Stick HD
deals.note: Turns an old TV into a smart one, with iPlayer, Netflix and Prime Video. TechRadar says this is a record low. It's HD, not 4K, so for a big modern TV see our [tech gifts under £50](/guides/tech-gifts-under-50-uk/) for the Fire TV Stick 4K at £31.99.

deals.name: Inui 45W 10,000mAh portable charger
deals.note: A fast, pocket-sized power bank for phones, tablets and handheld consoles. Not glamorous, but it will be used every week.

deals.name: Tapo P110 smart plugs (2-pack)
deals.note: Put the Christmas tree lights on a timer, or switch a lamp from your phone. These also show how much electricity each device uses. About £1 above their recent low.

deals.name: Amazon Basics AA alkaline batteries (48-pack)
deals.note: The most useful thing under the tree on Christmas morning, when a new toy needs batteries. A good add-on gift for a family with young children.

deals.name: Gritin resistance bands (set of 5)
deals.note: Five bands at different strengths for home workouts or physio stretches, with a carry bag. A cheap, thoughtful gift for someone with a new-year fitness plan.

deals.name: Anker USB-C charging cable (2-pack)
deals.note: Everyone needs a spare cable. Anker's are tougher than the ones in the box. An easy stocking filler alongside a bigger present.

body:
## Best Christmas gifts under £20 at a glance

- **Best overall:** Lego Botanicals Happy Plants, £11.99 at Amazon
- **Best for film fans:** Lego Back to the Future Time Machine, £14.99 at Amazon
- **Best for light sleepers:** Loop Quiet 2 ear plugs, £15.95 at Amazon
- **Best tech:** Fire TV Stick HD, £17.99, or the Inui power bank, £17.70, both at Amazon
- **Best stocking filler:** Anker USB-C cables (two), £5.69 at Amazon

## How to choose a gift under £20

At this price, the gifts that land best are either a small treat they wouldn't buy themselves or something practical they'll use every day. The Lego sets fall into the first group: they're a fun hour or two to build, and then they sit on a desk or shelf for years. The power bank, smart plugs, cables and batteries are in the second group. They're less exciting to unwrap, but they're used long after the chocolates have gone.

Think about who it's for. Lego Botanicals and Speed Champions sets are designed for adults and older children as much as kids, so they work for a colleague, a teenager or a grandparent who likes a puzzle. Ear plugs are a kind gift for a light sleeper or someone sharing a room. Resistance bands suit anyone who has talked about getting fit in January, but avoid them for someone who might take the hint the wrong way.

For a Secret Santa with a lower limit, see our [Secret Santa gifts under £10](/guides/secret-santa-gifts-under-10/) and [stocking fillers under £5](/guides/stocking-fillers-under-5/). For children, our [Christmas gifts for kids under £20](/guides/christmas-gifts-for-kids-under-20/) has toys picked by age.

## A gift that costs nothing up front

If the person you're buying for loves books or podcasts, an Audible subscription makes a good add-on to a small present. New members can start with an [Audible free trial](https://www.amazon.co.uk/hz/audible/mlp), which includes a credit for any audiobook. Avid readers with a Kindle can try [Kindle Unlimited free](https://www.amazon.co.uk/kindle-dbs/hz/subscribe/ku) first. Remind them to cancel before the trial ends if they don't want to pay.

## What's a good price?

From this year's Black Friday prices:

- Lego Botanicals Happy Plants: under £12 is the lowest we've seen
- Lego Speed Champions sets: £15 or less is a good deal
- Fire TV Stick HD: under £20 is a record low
- 10,000mAh power bank: under £20
- Two-pack of smart plugs: £13–£15

## When do prices drop?

Cheap gifts don't usually get much cheaper after Black Friday. Amazon's Black Friday Week runs until Cyber Monday on 30 November, and some lines sell out before then. After that, prices tend to rise again until the [Boxing Day sales](/guides/boxing-day-sales-2026-uk/), which is too late for Christmas. If you see something on this list at the price shown, it makes sense to buy now.

Many Amazon prices are for Prime members, and small orders may need Prime for free delivery. A [Prime free trial](https://www.amazon.co.uk/amazonprime) covers the sale and Christmas delivery, and you can cancel before you're charged.

### What is a good Christmas gift under £20?

A small Lego set, such as Botanicals Happy Plants at £11.99, or something practical like a power bank or a Fire TV Stick HD. Both kinds get used long after Christmas.

### Are Lego sets good gifts for adults?

Yes. Lego makes Botanicals, Icons and Speed Champions sets mainly for adults, and the smaller ones are well under £20. They're relaxing to build and look good on display.

### Is a Fire TV Stick HD worth it?

For an older or smaller TV, yes. It has all the main streaming apps. For a 4K TV, the Fire TV Stick 4K is worth the extra money.

### How do I make a cheap gift feel special?

Pair a small item with something personal: a Lego set with a handwritten note, or a power bank with a gift card for their favourite coffee shop.

### Will these gifts be cheaper on Cyber Monday?

Probably not. Amazon tends to hold Black Friday prices through Cyber Monday, and popular low-priced items can sell out first.
